title: refactor(driver-sql): move introspectIndexes's body out of sql-driver.ts into sql-driver-introspection.ts (#25521 cut 5)
body:

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DRkza71oHtDYy29jXfxjhrY)_

Part of #25521
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: 6270097840
Ruling-ref: 6348891160

Cut 5 of the `sql-driver.ts` split (#24586 ruling A, recorded in `6270097840`). The claim is `6408067063`. The body of the protected `SqlDriver#introspectIndexes` moves unedited into cut 1's module, `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-introspection.ts`, and reaches the class through cut 1's host, `IntrospectionHost`, which gains one member. The method keeps its name, docblock, signature (less `async`) and position. `resolveHashShadowKeys`, the one class method the body calls, stays in the class with the rest of the hash-shadow family.

It is move-only, and the card stays open for the later cuts. Branch `claude/project-thread-8aooxu` (platform-assigned to this card thread, as the claim records), cut from `origin/main` at `f00e8d5c8` (cut 4 merged as `b1790841b` before it).

**Net line count (the seat's rule from ACCEPT `6385306916`).** `sql-driver.ts` goes from 21,595 lines at base to 21,512 at head: **-83** (cut 4 priced it at about -82). `sql-driver-introspection.ts` goes from 800 to 927 lines.

**Serial with the file's in-flight PRs.** At claim the seat read no open PR touching `sql-driver.ts` (hot-file queue on seat post #20966: this is the one slice in flight). Re-measured just before this PR was opened: 8 open PRs, each file list read in full. None touches `packages/drivers/driver-sql/**`, `driver-turso/**` or `driver-sqlite-wasm/**`, except the Version Packages PR #25640, which touches only those packages' `CHANGELOG.md` and `package.json`. `origin/main` moved one commit past the base meanwhile (#25904, now `2a728ba2a`). It touches no driver package and no gate script this diff derives, and it merges clean, so `main` is not merged in.

## The area, re-measured at `f00e8d5c8`

- `introspectIndexes` with its docblock is lines 15096-15250 of `sql-driver.ts` (155 lines; the method itself 15143-15250). `git blame` with `--since` 30 days before the base attributes **0** of those lines to the last 30 days; the file has 63 commits in that window (the clone's history was deepened to 2026-09-20, before the window opens, for the reading).
- It is protected, and its return type is annotated (a promise of `PhysicalIndex[]`), so the inferred-return limit does not bite.
- It does not build through `getBuilder` (`check:tenant-chokepoint` rule 1: 24 bindings across 3 files at both ends).
- It reads no static: the fields and getters it reads are `knex`, `isMysql`, `isPostgres` and `isSqlite`, all already `IntrospectionHost` members, plus the method `resolveHashShadowKeys`.
- It has no `this.FIELD.delete/insert/update(` site: its `.set(` / `.get(` / `.push(` calls are on a local `Map` and local arrays.
- `insertOnlyUpsertColumns` is not touched (#8740).

## The shape (#23050 shape B, as cuts 1-4 apply it)

- The class keeps `introspectIndexes`, docblock and parameter JSDoc included, byte-identical except that `async` is dropped. Its body is now one host literal plus `introspectIndexes.call(host, tableName, opts)`, marked `[#25521 cut 5]`. It returns the moved function's own promise, so a caller awaits the same settlement.
- `IntrospectionHost` gains one member, `resolveHashShadowKeys`, typed as the class member (an indexed access on `SqlDriver`). Its ten existing member lines are unchanged. The moved function types its `this` as the `Pick` of the host over exactly the five members its body reads, and the stub annotates its literal as the `ThisParameterType` of the moved function. There is no cast, and no member becomes public.
- `knex` and the three dialect getters go as GETTERS that read the driver at call time. `resolveHashShadowKeys` goes as a late-bound closure that calls it on the driver, so a subclass override or an instance spy is still the one the body reaches.
- **Why `resolveHashShadowKeys` stays.** The claim's surface allows the helpers only `introspectIndexes` calls, and it is one of them (its only caller). But the series carries "protected statics keep the hash-shadow family in the class" (cut 4's release `6388161035`), and cut 4's proposal for this cut kept it too, so it is left for the seat to price as its own slice (see the acceptance notes).
- **Module-level declarations.** The body reads `parseIndexDdl`, `applyIndexKeyParts` and the type `PhysicalIndex`. All three live in `schema-drift.ts`, which exports them, so the module imports them from there (not a copy). After the move `sql-driver.ts` no longer reads the two functions, so they leave its `./schema-drift.js` import list; `PhysicalIndex` stays there, other members still read it. No declaration gains an `export`. `index.ts` re-exports nothing from this module.
- The move was produced by a script from the source text, not retyped: the parameter list, return type and body lines, re-indented two columns, except the 9 lines that continue one of the body's two multi-line SQL template literals. Those keep their bytes (cut 1's rule: there the indentation is statement text).
- Cut 1's module header gains a `[#25521 cut 5]` paragraph, and the import comment in `sql-driver.ts` is re-worded to name `introspectIndexes`. Both are comment-only.

### Overrides and spies, measured

- `TursoDriver` overrides `introspectIndexes` and calls `super.introspectIndexes(tableName, opts)` on its local arm. The class method is still there and hands the body its host.
- `SqliteWasmDriver` overrides the getter `isSqlite`. The host reads it through a getter that reads the driver.
- `sql-driver-12732-varchar-emitter-parity-wiring.test.ts` spies on `introspectIndexes` on the instance; that is still the class method.
- A scratch probe against the built `dist` (not committed) gave 18 readings, **identical at base and at head** (diff empty). It covered: the SQLite answer for a table with a primary key, a composite UNIQUE constraint, a plain index, a partial unique index and an expression index (columns, `partial`, `expressions`, `nullSafeColumns`); `getExistingIndexNames`; a missing table; a failing `PRAGMA index_info` under the default (rejects) and under `onFailure: 'partial'` (the short list); a `knex.raw` that throws synchronously (the method still returns a promise that rejects, at both ends); a subclass `introspectIndexes` that calls `super`; the MySQL arm through a subclass overriding the three dialect getters, with the `EXPRESSION` fallback statement; a subclass override of `resolveHashShadowKeys` and then an instance assignment of it (both reached); a rejecting `resolveHashShadowKeys` (surfaces by default, swallowed under `partial`); and a subclass `isSqlite` getter flipped between two calls (read at call time).

## The published `.d.ts` does not change

Under the series bar (ruling `6348891160`, letter A), measured on base `f00e8d5c8` and head `bd1670fe0`, each built with `pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-sql build` against the same dependency tree (the base leg restores the two base files into this worktree after the cut commit, rebuilds, reads, then restores HEAD, proved by blob hash and an empty `git diff HEAD`).

- This package emits `dist/index.d.ts` and `dist/index.d.mts` (no `.d.cts`); the two are identical at both ends.
- Raw sha256 of both files, base and head, all four the same: `93da45168e82136b7613944525e47402d5dc6f9f8daa9efa4bdceeaa11b52a89` (cuts 1-4's hash, unchanged). `cmp` base vs head: identical, raw diff 0 lines, so the proof rests on raw identity and no normaliser is relied on.
- Positive control on a copy of the head `dist/index.d.ts`: line 5714, `protected introspectIndexes(tableName: string, opts?: {`, with `protected` removed, gives `cbaacf3c70282bd8dfc867c2f97d0f218b114c06b7fc11fbde5b03f5c05f9da0` and a 4-line diff.
- Export tables: the ESM and CJS bundles each export the same 56 names at base and head. The sorted list hashes to `d61a9dd3a02661602b1bb2dbe18152ac43986148f36b2746f40c0884bd8ffdec` on all four (cut 4's value).
- The head build carries the move: `dist/index.mjs` 29 to 30 host `.call(` sites, `dist/index.js` 30 to 31.

No changeset: `skip-changeset`, per ruling `6348891160` item 4.

## Proof of move-only

- **Body, by AST token** (recursive `getChildren` leaves, template pieces as their exact source text, comments and JSDoc compared line by line less leading whitespace). The moved function's parameters (less the added `this`), return type and body have the same token sequence as the base method, and `async` matches. 673 body tokens compared, 0 differ; 2 parameters identical; return type identical.
- **Lines**: 98 body lines compared. 88 are the base line with two leading spaces removed, 9 are byte-identical template-literal continuation lines, 0 other.
- **Negative control**: in a copy of the module, `type = 'index'` becomes `type = 'indx'` inside the SQLite arm's `sqlite_master` template literal. The check then reports 1 token and 1 line different and exits `PROOF FAILED`, exit 1.
- **Class side**: 347 members at base and head. The 346 that did not move are byte-identical to base, leading trivia included.
- **Top level of `sql-driver.ts`**: 202 non-class statements at base and head; 200 byte-identical. The two others are the `./schema-drift.js` import (loses exactly `applyIndexKeyParts` and `parseIndexDdl`) and the `./sql-driver-introspection.js` import (gains exactly `introspectIndexes`; its leading comment re-worded).
- **The module**: 9 statements at base, 11 at head. The 8 base statements other than `IntrospectionHost` are byte-identical at head (the first carries the re-worded header as leading trivia). `IntrospectionHost` keeps its ten member lines and gains one. The two new statements are the `./schema-drift.js` import and the moved function.
- **Size**: +143 / -99 over 2 files, far under the 3,000-line manual-merge line.

## Readers of `sql-driver.ts` by path, checked against the moved text

None needed an edit:

- **ADR anchors.** `scripts/adr-anchors/packages__drivers__driver-sql__src__sql-driver.ts.json` carries ADR-0053 (`formatOutput`, `presentReadValue`) and ADR-0120 D4 (the `recreate_index` ceremony). Neither paragraph describes the moved body, so per card ask 3 no entry is owed. The moved body cites no ADR; the docblock's ADR-0048 mention stays on the class. `check:adr-anchors`: 85 anchored files at both ends; decision-letter citations on the anchored surface **1,847 at base and 1,847 at head**.
- **Symbol anchors.** No ADR, checklist or doc anchors `sql-driver.ts#introspectIndexes` (`git grep` over `docs/`, `content/`, `scripts/`, `.github/`: 0 hits). `check:adr-symbol-anchors`: 2,474 anchors resolve at both ends.
- **`check:tenant-chokepoint`.** Rule 1 verdict and population unchanged (above). Rule 2 visits raw-family calls in `SCAN_FILES`; the moved body's five `knex.raw(` call sites (`sqlite_master`, `PRAGMA index_list`, `PRAGMA index_info`, `pg_index`, MySQL `STATISTICS`) are catalog reads, none says `IS NULL` against a tenant column (the `pg_index` read says `ix.indpred IS NOT NULL`, not a tenant column). Verdict unchanged; `.raw(` call sites in `sql-driver.ts` go 75 to 70 (see the acceptance notes).
- **Logger receivers.** The moved text reads no logger. `check:logger-receiver-detach`: 0 detaches at both ends.
- **Doc comments** that name `SqlDriver.introspectIndexes` (`schema-drift.ts`, `turso-driver.ts`, `packages/spec/src/contracts/schema-diff-service.ts`) and the `{@link introspectIndexes}` references in the class still point at the method, which is still there.
- `check:driver-conformance` at base and head: **55 covered, 0 in the DEBT ledger, 0 exempt, both times.**

## Verification

- `tsc --noEmit` (driver-sql) exit 0. `eslint --no-inline-config` over `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src` (265 files, the module included): 0 errors, 0 warnings. Repo-wide `pnpm lint` (the seat asked for it; driver-sql declares no lint script): exit 0 at head `bd1670fe0`.
- `packages/drivers/driver-sql` suite: base 3,999 tests (3,787 passed, 0 failed, 212 skipped; 247 files), head the same. Compared per test name and status from vitest's JSON reporter: 0 lost, 0 changed, 0 added.
- `packages/drivers/driver-turso` suite, against the rebuilt driver-sql `dist` at each end: base 2,526 tests (2,492 passed, 0 failed, 34 skipped; 95 files), head the same; per name 0 / 0 / 0 (2,513 distinct names, 13 repeat).
- `packages/drivers/driver-sqlite-wasm` suite: base 704 tests (704 passed; 39 files), head the same; per name 0 / 0 / 0.
- Each suite ran under its own `os-verify-lock` call, `VERDICT command-exit 0` at both ends.
- `dispatch-gates --commands` on this diff, at head `bd1670fe0`: 55 derived commands, each run with its exit code captured before any pipe. `--ran` reconciles 55 derived, 54 run, 1 NOT MEASURED, 0 unrun. The NOT MEASURED one is `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET: it needs every package's `dist`), which CI runs. `check:lean-entry-closure` first exited 3 (no `objectql` dist) and exits 0 after `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/objectql`; `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` first exited 3 on the shallow clone and exits 0 after `git fetch --unshallow`.
- `check:commit-card-trailers --range origin/main..HEAD`: 1 commit, clean.
- No reverse verification or ablation: the diff changes no tested behaviour.

## Acceptance notes

- **`check:tenant-chokepoint` rule 2 reads 5 fewer raw call sites in `sql-driver.ts`.** `SCAN_FILES` names `sql-driver.ts` and not the seam modules, so rule 2 no longer visits the five catalog `knex.raw(` calls that moved; the module now holds 24 `.raw(` sites. None is an arm on a tenant column today, but a future edit that added one in the module would not be caught by rule 2. Widening `SCAN_FILES` is a gate edit and the open precondition the series carries for the `getBuilder` areas; it is not made here.
- **`resolveHashShadowKeys` could follow.** Its only caller is now the moved body, its body reads only `knex` and two `schema-drift.ts` functions (no static), and its body (about 29 lines) is longer than the stub it would need (about 7), so it would pass the net-line rule at roughly -22. It stays because the series keeps the hash-shadow family in the class; whether it moves is the seat's call.
- **Proposed cut 6** (cut 4's next candidate, re-read here): the SQLite rebuild pair `applyDriftOpInPlace` (14860) and `rebuildSqliteTablePatched` (14954), Schema sync. Neither builds through `getBuilder` and neither has a `this.FIELD.delete/insert/update(` site. Between them they read `knex` (14 times), `logger` (twice, so `check:logger-receiver-detach` is the gate to watch on a host getter), `dialectName`, `isMysql`, `isPostgres`, and the methods `introspectColumns`, `syncTableIndexes`, `resolveTenantField`, `nowColumnDefault`, `buildRebuiltColumn`, `applyIndexDriftOp`, `applyDeclaredColumnDefault`, plus the fields `managedObjectIndexes` and `managedObjectFields`. That is a wide host; it should be priced against the net-line rule at its dispatch.
- `TursoDriver`'s `introspectIndexes` override still calls `super.introspectIndexes(tableName, opts)`. That now returns the moved function's promise instead of an `async` method's promise. A caller awaits the same settlement, and a synchronous throw inside the body still arrives as a rejection (probe reading 6).
- Lines that continue a SQL template literal keep their base indentation inside the module, so they sit two columns deeper than the code around them (cut 1's rule).
